comment: Per MASTER2 LLM.md - bash permitted for git/ruby/bundle invocations only. All other shell ops use zsh. rbenv is allowed so Rails/MASTER commands can honor the repository's .ruby-version. vm23 ssh/curl deliberately NOT here: settings.local.json already grants Bash(ssh *) personally, and this file is committed - production access belongs in a per-operator file, not one that ships to whoever clones. The PreToolUse Bash hook refuses banned non-native tools (awk, bash, cut, find, head, perl, python, sed, tail, tr, wc) on the whole command string, pipes included; the remaining hooks rebuild generated assets, load the constitution as context, and speak the reply.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE '\b(awk|bash|cut|find|head|perl|python|sed|tail|tr|wc)\b' && { echo 'Banned non-native tool (SHELL_DISCIPLINE/reach_non_native_tool): use the Read tool with offset/limit or a Ruby one-liner' >&2; exit 2; } || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */RAILS/*.scss) ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && ruby "$ROOT/MASTER/tools/rails/build_all_css.rb";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */MASTER/web/public/face.part*.txt|*/MASTER/web/public/face_speech_*.js) ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && cd "$ROOT/MASTER/web" && rbenv exec bundle exec rails assets:build_face_runtime;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
